quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 cash flow and capacity spending (interim report): net operating cash inflow RMB168.6 million vs a net outflow of RMB387.3 million a year earlier; cash and cash equivalents RMB1,578.1 million at June 30, 2026 (RMB879 million at December 31, 2025); capital expenditures RMB398.2 million, up RMB347.9 million year on year, for production-expansion equipment; capital commitments RMB700.4 million (RMB159.1 million at end-2025), primarily equipment relating to capacity expansion; adjusted net loss (non-HKFRS) RMB266,358 thousand. Revenue by region: Chinese Mainland RMB796,651 thousand (RMB489,640 thousand) and overseas RMB36,965 thousand (RMB63,714 thousand). Employees 1,391.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex RMB398.2 million; capital commitments RMB700.4 million; operating cash inflow RMB168.6 million

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 application details (interim report): white-goods revenue up 924% as products for air conditioners, refrigerators and other home appliances entered mass production; low-voltage motor-drive revenue RMB7 million (+685%); the low-voltage bidirectional VGaN BMS solution reached mass production at leading energy storage customers with sales revenue of RMB11.06 million; cumulative LiDAR shipments approaching 20 million chips; GaN chips for the 6.6kW OBC + 3.5kW DC/DC bidirectional on-board power supply system are mass-produced and deployed in vehicles; an automotive-grade high-voltage encapsulated GaN-IC was onboarded for mass production in EV OBCs. Management view: consumer electronics is shifting from the primary driver of revenue growth to a base for manufacturing scale and cash flow, industrial and energy storage drives near-term incremental growth, AI data center and new energy vehicle businesses are moving from product verification to scaled design-in, and humanoid robots offer longer-term growth.
quarterly_data.figure: White goods revenue +924%; VGaN BMS RMB11.06 million; motor drive RMB7 million (+685%)
